result.summary: Adds a unit test in net_tests.cpp checking that only non-inbound peers have their address moved from the new table to the tried table in AddrMan upon receiving a VERSION message. Inbound peers are tested to ensure their addresses remain in the new table.
result.problem: AddrMan address promotion on VERSION messages was untested against mutations, leaving room for regressions that could allow inbound peers to populate the tried table.
